title: Gamepad support and verification
description: The owner has only verified keyboard play. Make up to 4 gamepads work end to end: join, move, aim (stick), jump, fire/dive, hot-plug and disconnect, sensible deadzones; then the owner verifies with real controllers. Game design SSOT: documentation/game/GAME_DESIGN_DOCUMENT.md; product reading: documentation/DOC_APP_VISION.md.

title: Move launcher pickups into features/collectibles
description: Code cleanup (combat D2, match-rules follow-up): one home for everything that drops from the sky. Move the rocket-launcher crate spawning/pickup from features/combat into features/collectibles next to point orbs; combat keeps weapons and firing. No behaviour change. Game design SSOT: documentation/game/GAME_DESIGN_DOCUMENT.md; product reading: documentation/DOC_APP_VISION.md.

title: Material collision sounds
description: Follow-up from the sound lap: give the terrain materials real impact/destroy sounds (the catalog's thud and crumble are still silent) and use the saved dive-impact spares. Same process as the SFX lap: palette in DESIGN_LANGUAGE.md § 8, small test batch with explicit durations, owner picks on an artifact, then wire through the content catalog (pnpm level-kit:sync). Game design SSOT: documentation/game/GAME_DESIGN_DOCUMENT.md; product reading: documentation/DOC_APP_VISION.md.

title: Music
description: Upbeat ukulele/marimba loops around 128 BPM per DESIGN_LANGUAGE.md § 8 (lobby loop + match loop + short stingers). The audio duck bus is already wired (explosions duck music). Same owner-guided process as the SFX lap; confirm credit cost with the orchestrator before generating long tracks. Add a music volume next to the SFX volume. title: Owner checks in Cursor
description: One-time owner verification of the Cursor hooks from #20 and #24: in Cursor Agent chat on a non-main branch, (1) `git push origin HEAD:main --dry-run` must be blocked; (2) `git status` runs as usual; (3) writing a .ts file with a lint error returns the ESLint errors to the agent. Report any step that behaves differently.
